_about: Timing base (2026-10-26): g26's calls and cache, trained as the timing adapter that persona add-ons sit on. What to say is left mostly to the base model: the rest of each reply's words weigh 0.5 instead of 2.0, while the first words of a reply (the decision to speak, 'start' 6.0) and the moments that matter (warnings 5.0/2.2, stopping when cut in on 4.5, back-channels 2.05, listening once the caller is done 1.9) keep their weight. Help-desk openings ('How can I help?', 39% of the built calls) are not trained on. Only weights change, so g26's cache serves. g26t tried the same word weight with persona calls in and went quiet; this asks it without them. g26p (persona add-on at full strength on g26) halved g26's liveliness: timing first.
name: g26b
